rules: The review unit is a precise section-to-source edge (not the source URL alone). Some authored sections contain several propositions: even corroboration of one proposition never certifies the entire section.

Argument roles and speaker attributions are original authorial labels and do not determine evidence strength or whether a citation is an original proponent, opponent, primary document, or editorial interpretation.

No relationship is inferred automatically. A source edge without a claim-specific verdict in this NEW ledger may still have undergone earlier editorial screening, passage checks or historical research QA: consult formation-prior-audit-reconciliation.v1.json; do not initiate repeat audits from absence here.
For checked claims, record the precise substantiated proposition and source section along with limitations; an official translation is not a substitute for an original-language collation.

A source's being opened, or its author being named, does not certify an opponent's allegation as fact, an editorial inference as the source's assertion, or a contested claim as approved Catholic doctrine.
No original argument or source record is rewritten; no checked claim is automatically approved for public reading, quotation, theological certification, or translation.

PR #1198 four-role screening is reused with exact English/source-ID text equality, not promoted into independently verified claim propositions. Merged bounded primary finding IDs are carried forward only when the current source ID remains in the same original role.

checked_claims.claim_checked: Pius XII positively describes textual criticism, including the examination of scribal omissions and variants.
checked_claims.limitations: Confirms the textual-criticism claim only; the section's additional historical inferences and Qumran context remain unreviewed.

checked_claims.claim_checked: Justin accuses Jewish teachers of rejecting the Septuagint and removing passages; Trypho requests examples.
checked_claims.limitations: Source confirms what Justin alleges; not independent proof that deliberate manuscript removal happened; Greek text not collated.

checked_claims.claim_checked: Justin states that the disputed Jeremiah passage remained in some synagogue copies.
checked_claims.limitations: Only this concession checked; no independent conclusion about manuscript transmission or a whole community.

checked_claims.claim_checked: Pius XII allows qualified discussion of the body's origin from pre-existing living matter and requires the immediate creation of souls, distinguishing a prohibition regarding specified polygenist views.
checked_claims.limitations: Confirms these enumerated statements; broader doctrinal synthesis is not certified from one document.

checked_claims.claim_checked: The BioLogos editorial article argues for a historically large ancestral population and distinguishes that scientific inference from the historicity of a particular Adam or Eve.

checked_claims.limitations: Confirms accurate reporting of BioLogos's position, not independent scientific proof or Catholic magisterial approval.
